name: Розвиток фігур (3)
description:
In this lesson we will work on development again. Play a piece to an active square. Active pieces have a lot of freedom and have important targets in sight. In addition, castling is often a particularly useful developing move, because you activate the rook and bring the king to safety.

What do you have to do?

Develop a piece to an active square or castle.

examples.text: The black king is somewhat vulnerable. With 1...Bf5! black can play the bishop to a beautiful diagonal. The bishop fulfills both attacking and defensive tasks.
The black king is still in the center. Time to change that with castling.

texts: This creates an annoying pin on the black knight.
